description: K₂NaRhF₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. K is bonded to twelve equivalent F atoms to form KF₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent KF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent KF₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaF₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent RhF₆ octahedra. All K-F bond lengths are 3.01 Å. Na is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent RhF₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent KF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.25 Å. Rh is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form RhF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent KF₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Rh-F bond lengths are 2.01 Å. F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent K, one Na, and one Rh atom.
